device.description: MAC address of the default Bluetooth device to connect to.

profile.description: Default Bluetooth audio profile (e.g., a2dp, hfp).

codec.description: Codec to use. 'unchanged' allows negotiation of the best codec.

volume.description: Whether to change the hardware volume when a PCM is opened.

softvol.description: Whether to modify the software volume state when a PCM is opened.

delay.description: Manual delay compensation in microseconds. 0 lets the device report it.

ctl_device.description: Default MAC address for the control plugin (all devices).

ctl_extended.description: Enable extended controls for the bluealsa ctl plugin.

ctl_dynamic.description: Enable dynamic device handling in the ctl plugin.
